title: fix(mcp)!: offer a skill prompt only where the connection serves the tools it binds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDA16hWxCSMuLXAM7SRHKRg)_

Fixes #32767

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #32885

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:导出的 `registerSkillPrompts` 只把"所在 server 真开放了其绑定工具"的技能列给 MCP 客户端(平台 HTTP 入口和自建 server 的宿主都受影响);没绑工具的技能照旧列出。
- 为什么改:只读数据令牌(`data:read`)连上来时,会被推荐 `metadata_authoring` 等 9 个技能,里面教 AI 调用的 18 个工具这条连接根本没开放,AI 拿到的是跑不通的操作手册;云端目前靠自建代理过滤(cloud#4419)。
- 风险与回滚:属收窄(BREAKING,`@objectstack/mcp` minor):权限不全的连接看到的技能变少;绑定了任何连接都不开放的工具的技能,在所有连接上都不再列出(规格措辞由 #32885 跟进修正)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`(`skillBindingServed` 的匹配规则,尤其 `action_` 走 `run_action` 那一条),其次 `skill-prompts.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/skill-prompts.test.ts`,预期 27/27 通过,其中 `#32767` 一组 8 条全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- The exported `registerSkillPrompts(server, bridge)` (`packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts`) now offers a skill on `prompts/list` and `prompts/get` only when the server it is installed on serves every tool in the skill's `SkillSchema.tools` binding. The served list is read when the prompt request is answered, from the same registry the SDK's own `tools/list` answers from (its enabled entries). On `MCPServerRuntime`'s HTTP door that is exactly what the connection lists (native families per grant, plus the host's authoring family under `metadata:write`); a host that drives its own `McpServer` and calls `registerSkillPrompts` (the README's example, stdio included) is narrowed by its own server's registry the same way.
- Matching (`skillBindingServed`): a plain name must be listed; a trailing wildcard (`describe_*`) is served by any listed tool it matches; an `action_NAME` entry (or `action_*`) is served by that literal or wildcard match, or else when `run_action` is listed, because the native families serve AI-exposed actions through `list_actions` / `run_action` and register no `action_NAME` tool (the skill schema's own JSDoc says so); a host server that lists `action_NAME` by name serves it without the door. The door table is held to the spec's `PLATFORM_TOOL_FAMILY_PREFIXES` by a pin. A skill that binds no tool is offered as before.
- A withheld skill is unknown to `prompts/get`: it answers `-32602 Prompt "NAME" not found`, byte-for-byte the answer for a name no skill derives (pinned by comparing the two).
- No new export from the package entry and no signature change: `registerSkillPrompts(server, bridge)` and `listSkillPrompts(bridge)` keep their shapes; `skillBindingServed` is exported from the module for its unit pins only, not from `index.ts`.
- `mcp-server-runtime.ts`: one docblock sentence in `handleHttpRequest`'s Prompts paragraph; no code change there. `MCPServerRuntime.bridgePrompts` (the long-lived server's own skill projection) does not call `registerSkillPrompts` and is unchanged.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/mcp` minor (`Metadata-protocol: semantic`: `SkillSchema.tools` now decides whether a skill's instructions are offered over MCP), BREAKING narrowing of the prompt surface `registerSkillPrompts` installs, ADR-0087 not-required (the key keeps its shape; nothing at rest records which prompts a connection was offered).

## Why

On a `data:read` token, `/api/v1/mcp` `prompts/list` offered `metadata_authoring` and eight more skills naming 18 tools the connection does not list (cloud e2e `mcp-served-guidance-4337`, item 1). A skill's instructions are a playbook for its bound tools; offering one the connection cannot run misleads the client's model. Cloud filters through its own proxy today (objectstack-ai/cloud#4419); this is the framework half that replaces it. The card's first shape (narrowing by the served tool list) is implemented; no host seam was added.

## Tests

- New top-level describe in `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.test.ts`, driven through `handleHttpRequest` with a real grant and an injected authoring family:
  - a `data:read` connection lists only the skills whose bound tools it serves, and every plain bound tool of a listed skill is in that connection's own `tools/list`;
  - CONTROL: a connection granting `data:read`, `data:write`, `actions:execute` and `metadata:write` with the authoring family lists all seven fixture skills;
  - `prompts/get` of a withheld skill answers exactly like an unknown name; CONTROL: the same get serves the skill on the full connection;
  - unit pins for the action door, a family member listed by name without the door, the trailing wildcard, and every spec family prefix having a door.
- Fixture triage: the file's shared bridge now also carries an action half (`listActions` / `runAction`), so `CASE_SKILL`, which binds `action_resolve_case`, stays served on the existing pins; without it those pins would read a withheld skill.

## Acceptance notes

- `MCPServerRuntime.bridgePrompts` (the long-lived server, bridged from the internal registry) is not filtered by this change; the card measured the HTTP door. A host calling the exported `registerSkillPrompts` on its own server, stdio included, is filtered (see What changes).
- `SkillSchema.tools` prose (the class and key JSDoc and `.describe()` in `packages/spec/src/ai/skill.zod.ts`, `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx`, `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`) still says the binding is cloud-runtime-only and inert in the open framework. After this change the MCP prompt surface reads it as an offering gate (it still binds nothing). Outside this claim's file surface; follow-up #32885 corrects it in the same release.
- Accepted deviation (ADR-0150 D6): the served filter runs before the face list and the bare-name lookup, so a face (or bare name) two skills share is refused only where the connection serves both; where one is withheld, the remaining one is served under it. Withheld equals unknown, and a refusal would otherwise name a skill the connection is not offered.
- Accepted deviation: the action door is grant-level; it does not check that the named action exists or is runnable by this caller (the authoring-time `ai-skill-tool-unresolved` check covers the reference).
- If the SDK ever stops exposing its tool registry, the served list reads as unknown and every skill is offered as before this change; the data-only pin goes red on such an SDK, so the regression cannot pass silently.
- objectstack-ai/cloud#4419 (cloud's proxy) can be dropped after the next pin move that carries this change (carrier: cloud#4337).

## Verification

- Local gate pass at `e47ed23b` (pre-merge head; same four-file diff): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 64 families; all run plus `pnpm lint`. 62 exit 0; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, whole-tree build) and are NOT MEASURED locally, CI runs both; `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on the shallow clone and exits 0 after fetching its pinned commit.
- After the one `origin/main` merge (`975dd7d0`, no `packages/mcp` change on main, `#32766` not landed): rebuilt the `@objectstack/mcp...` closure and re-ran the mcp suite (63 files / 1063 tests pass), mcp typecheck, the changeset and closing-keyword families, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:nul-bytes`: all exit 0.
